subject: Temporary log retention exception & gated rollback plan
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@acmehealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Joseph Lin <joseph.lin@medtechco.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary retention exception for upcoming audit

Diego —

Thanks for taking a look. Acme Health has an external audit scheduled for Sep 28–30; our auditors require application logs and authentication events retained for 120 days. We understand Redwood's standard backup purge window is 30 days and there is a scheduled purge for Aug 25 that will remove the last tranche.

Can Redwood provision a temporary exception so those specific log streams are retained until Oct 31 (or provide an escrow copy)? We attached the auditor's request (Acme_Audit_Request.pdf) that notes scope.

Key asks:
- Confirm whether you can pause the purge for the specified buckets or provide a secure copy to an auditor escrow.
- Confirm what subprocessors are involved in log storage and any cross-border transfers.
- Provide a proposed DPA amendment or exception language so our legal can review.

Appreciate a quick turnaround — auditors asked us to lock this by Aug 20.

Best,
Alicia Gomez
Director, Compliance
Acme Health

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary retention exception for upcoming audit

Alicia —

Thanks for the note and the attachment. I can put this on our urgent queue. A few quick clarifying questions so we scope this narrowly (helps legal & ops):

1) Which specific log types do you need (application logs, auth events, request traces, error logs)? Please list the stream names or example paths if possible.
2) Is the scope tenant-specific (only Acme health tenant) or does it include cross-tenant aggregates?
3) Do you need read-only access for auditors, or is an escrow copy delivered to a third-party (CloudSecure) acceptable?

Operationally we have two options:
- Pause purge for the named buckets/streams until Oct 31 (preferred if limited scope).
- Create an encrypted escrow snapshot and transfer to a third-party auditor vault (CloudSecure) — requires paperwork + transfer authorization.

Looping in Kimberly for DPA amendment language and Karthik for feasibility/cost. I can block a short call if helpful.

—Diego
Diego Fernandez
Customer Reliability (Escalations)
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@acmehealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary retention exception for upcoming audit

Diego / Alicia —

I reviewed the auditor request. We can accommodate a scoped, temporary retention exception but need to document it as a DPA addendum with narrow parameters and an explicit rollback trigger. High-level legal notes:

- Scope: limit to the named Acme tenant and the explicit log streams the auditors identify. Do not include aggregated analytics or cross-tenant indexes.
- Duration: set a fixed window (e.g., Aug 20–Oct 31 2027) with automatic expiration.
- Subprocessors: this exception only applies to data stored with Redwood-managed storage and the subprocessors listed in our current subprocessor registry. If any additional subprocessors are required for escrow transfer (e.g., CloudSecure), they must be added to the Annex or explicitly authorized in the addendum.
- Transfer: if escrow or transfer outside the EU/UK is required, we need a cross-border addendum (standard SCCs) and evidence of the auditor's handling controls.

I've attached a short draft amendment (DPA_Amendment_Draft.docx) with placeholder fields for the log streams, duration, and auditor details. Once the fields are populated I'll route to legal for expedited sign-off.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@acmehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 10:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary retention exception for upcoming audit

Diego / Kimberly / Alicia —

Ops input on feasibility and timeline: we can implement a gated retention exception that targets only the specified S3-like buckets and log prefixes. Implementation plan and constraints:

- Action: postpone scheduled purge for buckets acme-prod-logs/* and acme-auth-evt/* between Aug 20 and Oct 31, 2027.
- Rollback trigger: automatic reversion to normal purge on Nov 1 unless an extension is authorized in writing by Acme legal and Redwood legal.
- Escrow: we can snapshot the two buckets and push an encrypted copy to CloudSecure; that will take ~48 hours to validate and transfer.
- Cost: estimated incremental storage + audit handling ~$2,400 (one-time) + ~$120 / month; will need procurement approval.
- Operational risk: retaining logs longer increases our retention surface; we will mark the objects with a temporary tag and restrict any downstream processing during the exception window.

Attached is a short schedule I prepared (backup-purge-schedule-v2.csv) with the proposed pause dates and the internal change ticket ID.

If you confirm the exact prefixes and whether CloudSecure is acceptable, we can schedule the change for Aug 20 morning PST.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Platform Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, CloudSecure LLP <audits@cloudsecure.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Aug 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary retention exception for upcoming audit

Alicia —

Thanks — summarizing agreed plan so all parties have a single source of truth (Kim and Karthik confirmed below):

1) Scope: Acme tenant only. Streams: acme-prod-logs/* (app logs), acme-auth-evt/* (auth events). Please confirm these are the exact prefixes; if different please reply with exact paths.
2) Duration: Exception window Aug 20 00:00 PST -> Oct 31 23:59 PST. Automatic rollback to standard 30-day purge schedule on Nov 1 unless extension is signed.
3) Escrow: We will create an encrypted snapshot and deliver to CloudSecure within 48–72 hours of confirmation. CloudSecure must confirm receipt and handling controls (cc'd).
4) Legal: Kimberly will insert the temporary exception as a limited addendum to the DPA. Draft is attached; Alicia, please review and confirm the auditor name for the addendum. Signatures will go through DocuSign: https://docusign.com/rooms/abc-acc-amendment
5) Cost: preliminary estimate ~$2,400 one-time + ~$120/mo. Procurement (if required) to approve.

Next steps for Acme (action items):
- Reply to this thread confirming the log prefixes (acme-prod-logs/*, acme-auth-evt/*) and auditor contact.
- If escrow transfer is preferred, confirm CloudSecure as the recipient and that they are authorized to receive the snapshot.
- Sign the DPA addendum via DocuSign once Kimberly finalizes the placeholder fields.

We will schedule the pause for Aug 20 08:00 PST if we have confirmation by end of day Aug 19. If we don't hear back we will still create the escrow snapshot on Aug 20 and proceed with normal purge for other objects.

Thanks — we'll keep this scoped and time-limited.

Diego Fernandez
Customer Reliability (Escalations)
Redwood Inference
